name: scene3d_sample_trajectory
description: Read the generated motion of a shot as world-space data (per-time root position + bbox, plus detected events: height peaks/valleys, pauses) so you can adapt scene props/cameras to what the body actually does. Read-only. Works for SOMA actors and keyframed objects. Optional objectIds (default: all animated), joints (semantic bone names, actors only), contextSamples. @see guides_get('scene3d')

contextSamples.description: Number of evenly-spaced context trajectory samples (default 10).

joints.description: Semantic bone names to include (e.g. Hip, Head, L_Hand, R_Hand, L_Foot, R_Foot). Actors with a skeleton only; ignored otherwise. Omit for the default set.

objectIds.description: Animated object ids to sample. Omit to sample all animated objects of the shot.
